title: Your Brain's Power: Less Than a Light Bulb
hook: Your brain runs on less energy than a dim light bulb?
script: Your brain runs on less energy than a dim light bulb? The human brain operates on just 20 watts of power. That's enough energy to light a 20-watt bulb. Yet, it outperforms supercomputers that consume millions of watts. This tiny organ accounts for about 2% of your body weight. Remarkably, it manages to fire around 86 billion neurons. Each neuron communicates using only 1-2 milliwatts per spike. In a single day, it generates more electrical impulses than all mobile phones combined.
